locator.section: 06-02 joint marcellinus peter erasmus, Secret; tempore paschali

entries.claim: The 06-02 joint marcellinus peter erasmus Secret prints the 22-word proper body (w001–w022) and the abbreviated cue Per Dóminum. The full w023–w044 conclusion and Amen are supplied separately from this edition’s RG115a, not printed in full here. Neighbouring prayers, chants, headings and rubric prose are excluded; this is not calendar, assembly or actor approval. This is the explicitly reprinted tempore paschali oration, not a new claim for the entire preceding non-Paschal Mass.

locator.section: Rubricae generales 115 a; ordinary conclusion addressed to the Father, including Amen

entries.claim: This separate rule supplies w023–w044: the ordinary 21-word conclusion and Amen. Each composite combines only loci of this same edition. Amen’s enumeration semicolon is literal; the selected separate response uses a period. This rule alone establishes no response actor or requirement to repeat each conclusion in an assembled commemoration group.

locator.section: no. 2707; 06-02 joint marcellinus peter erasmus, Secret; Paschal reference on p.543 / physical624

entries.claim: The 06-02 joint marcellinus peter erasmus Secret, item 2707, prints the 22-word body (w001–w022) followed by the cue Per Dóminum. Its full conclusion and Amen are separately supplied by this setting’s RG115a. This representative comparison does not claim a new literal transcript of all other dates, independent historical transmission, or whole-copy unaltered recension. This setting prints natalícia and a comma after offérimus, against selected Benziger natalítia and colon. The oration is printed in the non-Paschal context; the same face’s tempore paschali direction carries forward the preceding orations and Epistle only, not the entire non-Paschal Mass or its chants.
